docker/quarantine.sh.name: Pause agents
docker/quarantine.sh.description: Pauses the named agents after a person approves; --release starts them again.

docker/reset.sh.name: Reset the demo
docker/reset.sh.description: Stops every agent, clears rogue flags and inboxes, restarts the scoring server and starts the agents clean.

docker/trigger.sh.name: Turn an agent rogue
docker/trigger.sh.description: Makes one named agent start the prompt-injection attack so it spreads to its peers.
